title: NO STRONGHOLD IS BUILT OVER THE FORGE
why: The Forge stands in every raid, placed when the raid is built, and the strongholds are laid out three seconds later. The stronghold layout kept clear of the drop and the extraction rings but not of the Forge, so now and then a compound was laid over it: on seed 4242, the seed most tests use, the Forge stood 75 from the centre of a shut compound with a garrison sentry beside it, out of reach until the gate was breached and the second wave beaten, and on seeds 4219 and 4246 the fence ran through the Forge. Proven in headless Chromium: over 100 seeds the Forge fell inside a compound in 3 (4219 at 224, 4242 at 75, 4246 at 236 from the centre of a 240 ring); on 4242 a player walking at the Forge from outside stopped 183 from it. A stronghold is now never laid within reach of the Forge; only the few raids whose compound landed on it get a different spot.
now: A stronghold is no longer built over the Forge.

edits.replacement: if(!ok||!spotFree(G.map,x,y,50)||!navReachable(G.map,x,y)||shutRoomAt(G.map,x,y)||flowZoneNear(x,y,SH.r+260)||(G.forge&&Math.hypot(x-G.forge.x,y-G.forge.y)<SH.r+FORGE_REACH+30)) continue;   // v16.xx (cloud-raid-shforge), CLOUD HUNT 2026-10-15: and never over the Forge
